# Tailswatch

> Customizable Tailwind CSS 4+ themes with 43 ready-to-use theme presets.

A collection of 43 customizable Tailwind CSS 4+ themes for import into any application. Includes themes inspired by Bootswatch, Material Design, and popular programming languages. Each theme provides a comprehensive set of design tokens covering colors, surfaces, typography, and effects as CSS custom properties that integrate seamlessly with Tailwind CSS utility classes.

## Links

- [Documentation](https://quinnjr.github.io/tailswatch/)
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/quinnjr/tailswatch)
- [npm Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/tailswatch)

## Key Features

- 43 ready-to-use themes for Tailwind CSS 4+
- 25 Bootswatch-inspired themes (cerulean, cosmo, cyborg, darkly, flatly, journal, litera, lumen, lux, materia, minty, morph, pulse, quartz, sandstone, simplex, sketchy, slate, solar, spacelab, superhero, united, vapor, yeti, zephyr)
- 12 Material Design themes in light and dark variants
- 4 programming language-inspired themes (oxide/Rust, gopher/Go, evergreen/Node.js, kernel/C/C++)
- 2 base themes (default light and dark)
- Comprehensive design tokens: colors (50-950 shades), surfaces, typography, and effects
- CSS custom properties for direct use outside Tailwind classes
- Dynamic theme switching support
- Import via CSS @import or JavaScript/TypeScript import
- Custom theme creation support

## Installation

```bash
npm install tailswatch
# or
pnpm add tailswatch
```

## Quick Start

Import a theme in your CSS alongside Tailwind:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "tailswatch/themes/cosmo";
```

Or import directly in JavaScript/TypeScript:

```js
import "tailswatch/themes/cosmo";
```

Your Tailwind classes will now use the selected theme's colors and design tokens.
